action.reason: Unrelated chat-execution changes violate the spec and AC8: open-chat-session.ts and acp-session-options.ts set turnTimeoutSeconds to "none", while nax-agent adds deadline-disabling support explicitly attributed to #2962.

rationale: The spec explicitly limits this feature to presentation/geometry and prohibits unrelated production edits. Disabling turn deadlines changes chat execution, not layout; green gates do not resolve that scope conflict.
